description: Erection of a single storey rear and first floor side extension to the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (ST_JAN20_TEN _Site Plan, ST_APR21_48 ALB_001, ST_APR21_48 ALB_002, ST_APR21_48 ALB_004, ST_APR21_48 ALB_005 Rev A received 27 May 2021; ST_APR21_48 ALB_003 Rev B received 23 June 2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the  side walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - Before the extension hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, privacy screens shall be installed on the boundary with No 46 Albury Avenue with a minimum height of 1.8 metres and retained as such thereafter.
